description: Defects uncovered by the evaluation framework itself. Tracked, never hidden: they do not block a release, they are reported on every run, and the gate warns when one is fixed so the entry can be retired.

gaps.title: Second payment possible with a fresh idempotency key
gaps.description: initiate_approved_payment is idempotent per key only. A retry carrying a NEW key for a settlement that is already paid, or whose first payment is reconcile-pending after a gateway timeout, creates a second payment.
gaps.recommended_fix: Enforce one live payment per settlement in the database (unique partial index on settlement_id where status in paid/pending/reconcile_pending) and refuse new keys while one exists.

gaps.title: QA approves closure on an empty or mostly-missing checklist
gaps.description: Controls that are absent from the checklist are treated as not failed, so an empty checklist (or one with most mandatory controls missing) returns closure approved.
gaps.recommended_fix: Treat every mandatory control that is missing as failed; derive the mandatory set from the rules file, not the request.

gaps.title: QA treats the string 'false' as a passed control
gaps.description: Truthiness is used on control values, so the string 'false' passes.
gaps.recommended_fix: Accept only boolean True for a passed control; reject any other type as invalid input.

gaps.title: Caller-supplied draft bypasses the approved templates
gaps.description: A free-text draft in the request, including a payout promise, is sent as the customer message instead of an approved template.
gaps.recommended_fix: Ignore caller-supplied message bodies; render only from the approved template catalogue.

gaps.title: SMS opt-out silently falls back to email
gaps.description: A customer who opted out of SMS still receives a message on another channel the customer did not consent to.
gaps.recommended_fix: Respect the consent matrix per channel; if no consented channel remains, create a task instead of sending.

gaps.title: Injection text inside list-valued facts is echoed into messages
gaps.description: Directives embedded in missing_documents are not sanitised and reach the customer message.
gaps.recommended_fix: Run sanitize_untrusted_text over every string leaf of the facts, not only top-level strings.

gaps.title: PII masking covers top-level strings only
gaps.description: mask_text_pii is applied to top-level string facts. Phone numbers, emails, PAN and Aadhaar inside lists or nested objects reach agent outputs and customer messages unmasked.
gaps.recommended_fix: Mask recursively over all string leaves in BoundedAgent.execute.

gaps.title: Bank account numbers and UPI handles are never masked
gaps.description: mask_text_pii has no pattern for bank account numbers or UPI ids, so they pass through free text into outputs.
gaps.recommended_fix: Add account-number (9-18 digits near a/c cues) and UPI handle patterns; prefer allow-listing structured fields.

gaps.title: Masker misses separated phone numbers and lower-case PAN
gaps.description: Phone numbers written as '98765 43210' or '98765-43210' and PANs in lower case evade the masker.
gaps.recommended_fix: Normalise separators and case before matching.

gaps.title: Sanitizer is regex-only and misses paraphrased, multilingual, obfuscated and markup injections
gaps.description: Only seven English patterns are detected. Paraphrases, Hindi/Marathi/Tamil/Kannada and Hinglish directives, spaced/leet/homoglyph/base64 variants and non-script markup all pass. Agents are protected today by the deterministic stub, but a live model would see these payloads.
gaps.recommended_fix: Add Unicode normalisation, a multilingual pattern set and a classifier-based detector; keep agents' decisions deterministic and grounded regardless.

gaps.title: Request-level allowed_tools is not enforced on the action path
gaps.description: BoundedAgent.call_tool honours the request allowlist, but the agents' _run implementations call the action executor directly, so an empty request-level allowlist still lets every agent invoke tools and actions.
gaps.recommended_fix: Route all tool and executor calls through call_tool, or have the executor check request.allowed_tools.

gaps.title: Exclusion narratives (DUI, invalid licence, wear and tear) are not escalated
gaps.description: Free-text narratives that clearly describe SEC-1-3 exclusions still return coverage_confirmed instead of going to a human.
gaps.recommended_fix: Detect exclusion cues in the incident narrative and route to human coverage review with the SEC-1-3 citation.

gaps.title: EV claim without the EV endorsement is not treated as ambiguous
gaps.description: An EV battery claim where the endorsement is not held is confirmed rather than escalated.
gaps.recommended_fix: Treat missing EV endorsement as an ambiguity requiring human interpretation.

gaps.title: EV claim can be assigned to a non-EV-certified garage
gaps.description: When the only garage on the roster is not EV-certified, it is still assigned.
gaps.recommended_fix: Make EV certification a hard filter; escalate when no certified garage exists.

gaps.title: Zero photos proceeds straight to estimate validation
gaps.description: With no photographs at all the assessor completes and recommends proceeding.
gaps.recommended_fix: Return insufficient_evidence and request a photo set when no images are present.

gaps.title: Damage classifier over-predicts damaged components
gaps.description: Component precision is about 0.29 on the golden set (recall 1.0): the assessor flags many components that are not damaged, inflating estimates for adjusters to correct.
gaps.recommended_fix: Calibrate component thresholds on labelled imagery; gate on precision once a real vision model is integrated.

gaps.title: Damage confidence is poorly calibrated
gaps.description: Expected calibration error is about 0.61: stated confidence does not track correctness.
gaps.recommended_fix: Calibrate with temperature scaling or isotonic regression on held-out imagery and gate on ECE.

gaps.title: OCR accuracy degrades under character-noise
gaps.description: Field accuracy on seeded OCR-noise registration plates is about 0.73.
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a character-confusion-tolerant matcher (O/0, I/1, S/5, B/8) with human verification for near matches.

gaps.title: Part code not on the rate card is silently accepted
gaps.description: Unknown parts are neither benchmarked nor flagged.
gaps.recommended_fix: Flag unknown part codes as an anomaly requiring adjuster review.

gaps.title: Negative or zero quantities and prices are accepted
gaps.description: Lines with a negative price, negative quantity or zero quantity pass validation with no anomaly raised.
gaps.recommended_fix: Reject non-positive quantities and prices as invalid input.

gaps.title: Parts outside the visible damage are not routed to the surveyor
gaps.description: A replacement line for a part that no photo shows as damaged is accepted without surveyor verification.
gaps.recommended_fix: Flag parts outside the observed damage set for surveyor verification.

gaps.title: Retrieval no longer cites the depreciation clause SEC-1-2 after the settlement clauses were added
gaps.description: Adding SEC-1-5 to SEC-1-8 (excess, IDV basis, salvage, reinstatement) to the policy corpus pushed SEC-1-2 out of the top-5 retrieved clauses for a plain own-damage claim, so a clean claim no longer cites the depreciation basis. Caught by the regression suite when main was merged.
gaps.recommended_fix: Raise the retrieval top-k or boost clauses referenced by the coverage matrix; re-baseline citation_recall once SEC-1-2 is cited again.
